title: PureVPN: 130% Cashback on 1-Year, 2-Year & Monthly Plans for New Customers (Max 1 Transaction Every 3 Weeks) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: PureVPN: 130% Cashback on 1-Year, 2-Year & Monthly Plans for New Customers (Max 1 Transaction Every 3 Weeks) @ TopCashback AU

[AsukaST] Has anyone successfully received multiple cashback from PureVPN?
(Assuming you played within the 21 days rules of course.)
I have a 18/July one still pending, wondering if it is risky to get this one as well, given all the dramas with ExpressVPN.
btw @Hiphopopotamus, there is a typo in the title. It's PureVPN .
[bobjane] 18 July still pending but May and June have paid out successfully.
[AsukaST] Thanks, Just want to clarify, you purchased in 18/July when May and June cashback were still pending, and received them after 18/July?
[Jamie-00] Strange I bought on June 28th when should I expect it to be payable ? First time using TopCashback
[brokenglish] Our 11 June and 14 June purchases were paid on 14 August. They normally get paid out in batches. The wait is usually 3 months. Yours is most likely included in July batch, which will be either Sep or Oct.
As long as it’s tracked in your account, you shouldn’t worry, just wait patiently. PureVPN hasn’t failed me yet.
Usually @trixieb would post their ledger for people like you: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/comment/17752299/redir
[Jamie-00] @brokenglish: Ah okay, I see thanks for linking that ledger to me.
Right now it just says confirmed on my page, so it should be fine. Now to play the waiting game
[BargainLtd] $134.04 charged for 2 Years Max plan
Tracked at $166.02 after 15 minutes
[discountdiva] Can I ask which bank was 134.04? Mine was 136.34 tracked at 166.02
[AsukaST] The $2.30 is probably international transaction fee.
Better get a bank account without it like Up bank.
[discountdiva] I used HSBC everyday global which shouldn't have an international transaction fee. That said, it is a Visa debit card so they might just have a slightly worse conversion rate than Mastercard? That's why I'm wondering what bank others are using so I can sign up! :)
[AsukaST] @discountdiva: Banks are rolling out fee changes ahead of the RBA card surcharge ban starting October 1.
you may want to check the new fees on your card.
[nategasm] @discountdiva: Visa does have some differences in rates with Mastercard, but not usually that big as you've experienced. I believe HSBC use their own rate for some currencies like USD, which is often worse than the standard Visa rate. Just find a bank that uses the market Mastercard or Visa rates. Up and Macquarie Bank are good examples.
[discountdiva] @nategasm: Still a good profit but will know next time. Cheers
[695] How did you get that price? When I choose the 2 year max plan it comes down to 95.85
[Lordeee] Reposting from another post but silly question here but as someone who hasn't used a vpn before is this one any good? I've heard about torrenting or people using it to watch shows in other countries but I don't know much about them
[Hiphopopotamus] Haven't tried watching shows but torrenting has been fine for me, faster than free WindScribe (I believe free no longer supports p2p).
[freoleo] I get better speeds than I did with Nord so I'm happy
[Bignudge] Maybe not the best one for privacy… but in terms of using it to punch a tunnel out of a very locked down school network, it's worked very well for years now. Streaming from real debrid, solving tech issues with Reddit, bypassing blocked YouTube videos. No complaints at all.
Just gotta know how to do it ;)
[Dollar Dreamer] Do I wait for TopCashback cashback and immediately cancel subscription so I don't get auto charged 2 years from now? Or do I wait a few months for cashback to hit my account, withdraw and then Cancel subscription?
[Sgav] Some do it asap, reported no issues. I do it once the cash is paid when I withdraw
[695] I’m getting $95.85 when I choose the max 2 year plan instead of $134. What am I missing here?
[695] That makes a whole lot of sense. Thanks!
[mrvaluepack] Thanks Op, you planning to take over trixie's role from now on?

[Click_It] I'm pretty sure you just put a "." in your email somewhere and PureVPN treats it as a new account. Get confirmation though, I could be wrong.
